events.label: founding
events.text: Division raised as the IV Division.

evidence.quote: The Eastern Army Division was raised on 1 August 1941 as the IV Division

events.text: Division and military district staffs moved to barracks at Lidingövägen 28, Stockholm.

evidence.quote: In 1949 , the two staffs were moved to the barracks of the Life Regiment of Horse

events.text: Mobilization responsibility transferred to Göta Life Guards.

evidence.quote: In 1957 , the mobilization responsibility for the division was transferred to the Göta Life Guards

events.text: Staff transferred to new property complex in Strängnäs Garrison.

evidence.quote: On 14 June 1963 , both staff were transferred to a new property complex in Strängnäs Garrison

events.text: Designation changed from Roman to Arabic numerals (4th Division).

evidence.quote: On 1 October 1966 , the designation was changed from being given in Roman numerals to Arabic numerals

events.text: Colonel Nils Östlund begins command.
Colonel Nils Östlund ends command.
Senior Colonel Sten Ljungqvist begins command.
Mobilization responsibility transferred to Uppland Regiment.

evidence.quote: and in 1970 to the Uppland Regiment

events.text: Senior Colonel Sten Ljungqvist ends command.
Senior Colonel Bengt Selander begins command.
Senior Colonel Bengt Selander ends command.
Senior Colonel Åke Lundin begins command.
Senior Colonel Åke Lundin ends command.
Senior Colonel Nils Rosenqvist begins command.
Division came under Middle Military District commander after district merger.

evidence.quote: On 1 July 1991 , the Bergslagen Military District and the Eastern Military District merged and formed the Middle Military District

events.text: Senior Colonel Ulf Henricsson begins command.
Senior Colonel Nils Rosenqvist ends command.

events.label: coat of arms
events.text: Coat of arms begins use.

evidence.quote: The coat of arms of the Eastern Army Division used from 1994 to 2000

events.text: Staff organized as cadre-organized unit within Middle Military District.

evidence.quote: As of 1 July 1994 , the army division staff , together with the Middle Army Division , came to be organized

events.text: Became only remaining army division in Svealand after Middle Army Division disbanded.

evidence.quote: the Middle Army Division was disbanded on 31
By the disbandment of the Middle Army Division , the Eastern Army Division became the only remaining army division in Svealand

events.text: Senior Colonel Ulf Henricsson ends command.
Senior Colonel Roland Ekenberg begins command.
Senior Colonel Roland Ekenberg ends command.

events.label: coat of arms
events.text: Coat of arms use ends.

evidence.quote: The coat of arms of the Eastern Army Division used from 1994 to 2000

events.label: medal
events.text: Commemorative medal of the Eastern Army Division established

events.label: disbandment
events.text: Division staff disbanded with the other army division staffs.

evidence.quote: the three army division staffs were disbanded on 30 June

events.text: Staff location in Strängnäs Garrison ends.

evidence.quote: where it was located in various forms until 2005
